observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Dance studio with wooden floors and wall mirrors.
observation.dancers: Mixed group of male and female dancers in traditional and rehearsal attire.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers move in rows and formations across the studio floor.
observation.posture: Upright torso with flexible movement, knees bent in low stances at times.
observation.footwork: Stepping and shifting weight in rhythm with the music; specific foot details partially obscured by wide skirts and trousers.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms raised and undulating with detailed wrist and finger movements, some holding small stone castanets (kairok).
observation.hips_and_torso: Fluid horizontal and vertical waves through the torso.
observation.partnering: None, dancers perform independently or in ensemble coordination.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low knee bends and turns executed across the floor.
observation.costume_and_props: Women wear bright yellow dresses with patterned vests, headpieces with white feathers, and braided hair. Men wear dark trousers, tall fur hats, and patterned tunics. Some hold stone castanets.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork precision and weight distribution are partially obscured by long garments and quick camera angles.

signature_moments.what: Group unison arm waving and wrist articulation while stepping in formation.
Male dancers performing low squatting steps with alternating leg extensions.
Female dancers extending arms overhead with fluid wrist rolls while spinning.
